body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2013') -- Radio Gears, an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence (President Park, Sae-geun www.radiogears.com) unveiled its IPTV STB for overseas residents at the world's largest consumer electronic show, CES 2013 from Jan 8 to 11.
This IPTV STB product which you can watch recorded drama, movies, videos through TV without internet connection. It added IPTV function to its media player function of existing product.
It also provides web surfing, messaging service function based on Android OS and provides people with various visual treats such as sports, entertainment, social club and etc.

The company officials said " Our product is for overseas residents that they can watch their native broadcast anywhere with this STB and wirelessly with their smart phone. In addition, STB is applied image advertisements for users not to get bored in contents loading.
